name: contract-registered-results
goal: Compare every registered class result with its authored expectation and reject unregistered example implementations

evidence: The new registerCases runner compares JSON only for API cases. Class callbacks can return wrong values without failing their authored expected result. registerExamples also ignores unsupported implementations, weakening exact registration admission.

The existing registerCases initialized case checks API value differences but only checks execution count for a void class callback. Strengthen that same method case with correct and wrong void, value and error outcomes. Extend the existing registerExamples method case with an extra implementation mapping; keep all four cases and their identities unchanged.
